draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Vasco da Gama! This port city at the mouth of the Zuari is named after the Portuguese explorer, and it grew up alongside Mormugao Port, one of India's oldest ports.
draft.hungryLine: Vasco has proper Goan food, and Vasco Inn is the place to try chicken cafreal, vindaloo, xacuti and caldine.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Tilak Maidan is a 6 min walk and the Ravindra Bhavan-Mormugao Port Bridge is about 13 min away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head up to the Japanese Garden at Sada, on a hilltop facing the ocean, and sit and watch the ships.
moodReplies.surprise-me: In March 1943, a secret British raid called Operation Creek sank the German ship Ehrenfels in Mormugao Harbour, because it was sending information to U-boats.

spots.name: Tilak Maidan
spots.detail: 6 min walk · Football ground with a Harbour End and a City End

spots.name: Ravindra Bhavan-Mormugao Port Bridge
spots.detail: 13 min walk · Vasco's new cable-stayed bridge, opened in January 2025

spots.name: Naval Aviation Museum
spots.detail: On the way to Bogmalo beach · Vintage aircraft from Sea Harriers to a Super Constellation

tips.title: Go to Sada early or late.
tips.body: The Japanese Garden at Sada is quiet in the day, and early mornings or evenings are the ideal time to visit.

tips.title: Mind the waves at Bogmalo.
tips.body: Bogmalo is a small beautiful beach behind the airport, but the water there can get very rough.

story.title: The explorer's voyage
story.body: Vasco da Gama's first voyage linked Europe and Asia by sea around the southern tip of Africa. The city now carries his name.

story.title: Port and city
story.body: Mormugao Port was set up on a natural harbour in the 1880s, and the city was developed alongside it.

story.title: Operation Creek
story.body: During World War II, men of the Calcutta Light Horse and Calcutta Scottish attacked the German ship Ehrenfels in the harbour at night. It and three other Axis ships were sunk.

story.title: Shipyard and freedom
story.body: The shipyard now run by Goa Shipyard Limited was built in 1957, and the city stayed Portuguese until the 1961 Indian military operation that annexed Goa.

story.title: A busy port town
story.body: Mormugao Port is still a busy shipping route and the biggest employer around Vasco. A new cable bridge opened on 21 January 2025.

food.name: Vasco Inn
food.detail: Near IOC · Known for Goan food, try the chicken cafreal, xacuti and caldine

food.name: Annapurna
food.detail: Near the Municipal Market · Vegetarian, try the paneer makhanwala or biryani

food.name: City Shack
food.detail: Near the municipal garden · Go for the handi biryani and fish dishes
